content:
As some of the holes in their memory begin to reshape themselves, Web remembers.
||They remember Solomon's booming voice calling for Rah's death. They remember voting 'mercy'. They remember seeing the shock on the other's faces when Solomon stated what Rah had done. They remember being scared, angry, and afraid. They remember hissing, chirring, foaming at the mouth and becoming feral in rage and confusion. THey remember asking Rah what he had done. They remember Rah lying. They remember feeling scared, scared of being thought a villain. Scared of maybe being one. They remember the looks on Ebuc and Goanhawe's faces as Goanhawe changed his vote to death. They remember Goanhawe angrily yelling at Ebuc to vote for death. They remember Ebuc agreeing. They remember shifting back into normal, and managing to spit out the word 'death'. Oh god. They remember voting for Rah's death. They remember a cage of force being created around Rah. They remember watching as Solomon drained Rah's life force. They remember curling up, horrified for what they had done. They remember asking to forget, choosing ignorance over responsibility. Over guilt.|| 
They remember, and begin to sob.

*Please, Lord Ilmater, grant my friends Navar the Goldenheart, Amara the Bard, Calmation, and Ebuc the Clever endurance in their fight at a time when you still live. Please grant them the strength to overcome in their fight, and let them return home to those who love them. If they are to fall, please protect their souls as they take the hero’s path to the afterlife. They wish to restore you, as I do. Please, grant them your endurance. Your faithful servant, Faewynne Aidrin Cobblepot.*
